title: Measure levels, predict aliases, and resample
brief: Build decibel helpers, sample a tone, predict the frequency any tone aliases to, and resample with a windowed-sinc filter that matches scipy's resample_poly.
hints: A level in dBFS is 20 * np.log10(max(value, eps)); use 20 because the value is an amplitude, not a power.
The alias is the distance to the nearest multiple of the sample rate: abs(f - fs * np.round(f / fs)).
np.sinc(u) is sin(pi u) / (pi u), so 2 * fc * np.sinc(2 * fc * m) is the ideal low-pass response for a cutoff of fc cycles per sample.
Zero-stuff with stuffed = np.zeros(len(x) * up); stuffed[::up] = x. After np.convolve, the first output sample you keep is at index half, not 0.
The ceiling of a / b for positive integers is -(-a // b).
